question: Among healthcare providers whose practice location is in Mountain View, CA, and who have a specified specialization in the field healthcare provider taxonomy, identify the top 10 most common specializations based on the count of distinct NPIs. Then determine which of those top 10 has a count of distinct NPIs closest to the average count across those 10 specializations.

WITH mountain_view_providers AS (
  SELECT npi,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_1_specialization AS spec1,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_2_specialization AS spec2,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_3_specialization AS spec3,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_4_specialization AS spec4,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_5_specialization AS spec5,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_6_specialization AS spec6,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_7_specialization AS spec7,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_8_specialization AS spec8,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_9_specialization AS spec9,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_10_specialization AS spec10,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_11_specialization AS spec11,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_12_specialization AS spec12,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_13_specialization AS spec13,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_14_specialization AS spec14,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_15_specialization AS spec15
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nppes.npi_optimized`
  WHERE LOWER(provider_business_practice_location_address_city_name) = 'mountain view'
  AND provider_business_practice_location_address_state_name = 'CA'
),
all_specializations AS (
  SELECT npi, spec1 AS specialization FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec1 IS NOT NULL AND spec1 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec2 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec2 IS NOT NULL AND spec2 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec3 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec3 IS NOT NULL AND spec3 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec4 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec4 IS NOT NULL AND spec4 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec5 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec5 IS NOT NULL AND spec5 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec6 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec6 IS NOT NULL AND spec6 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec7 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec7 IS NOT NULL AND spec7 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec8 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec8 IS NOT NULL AND spec8 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec9 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec9 IS NOT NULL AND spec9 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec10 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec10 IS NOT NULL AND spec10 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec11 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec11 IS NOT NULL AND spec11 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec12 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec12 IS NOT NULL AND spec12 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec13 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec13 IS NOT NULL AND spec13 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec14 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec14 IS NOT NULL AND spec14 != ''
  UNION ALL SELECT npi, spec15 FROM mountain_view_providers WHERE spec15 IS NOT NULL AND spec15 != ''
),
specialization_counts AS (
  SELECT specialization, COUNT(DISTINCT npi) AS distinct_npi_count
  FROM all_specializations
  GROUP BY specialization
  ORDER BY distinct_npi_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(distinct_npi_count) AS avg_count FROM specialization_counts
)
SELECT sc.specialization, sc.distinct_npi_count, ac.avg_count,
  ABS(sc.distinct_npi_count - ac.avg_count) AS diff_from_avg
FROM specialization_counts sc, avg_count ac
ORDER BY diff_from_avg ASC
LIMIT 1
